title: Sync source data
permission: Updating both user accounts and people is required.
help: Fetch the linked source and compare before applying. Existing values and manually fixed blanks are kept; usernames are unchanged.
chooseAccountPlaceholder: Select an account; none is selected automatically
noAccounts: This person has no linked accounts.
accountCount: {count} account(s), up to 50 from this page
summary: {fill} field updates · {preserve} preserved · {protected} protected or unavailable fields · {unavailable} accounts need attention
expiry: Previews expire after 5 minutes. Changed or failed previews must be fetched again before applying.

reasons.disabled: Manual sync is not enabled. Ask a deployment administrator.
reasons.source_disabled: The source is not enabled for synchronization.
reasons.source_untrusted: The source is not trusted for synchronization.
reasons.source_namespace_mismatch: The configured source does not match this account's binding.
reasons.binding_missing: No established source binding is available.
reasons.binding_ambiguous: Several source bindings match. An administrator must resolve the binding.
reasons.person_missing: This account has no linked person record.
reasons.configuration_invalid: Manual sync configuration needs an administrator's attention.
reasons.source_unavailable: The source is unavailable. Preview again later.
reasons.source_not_found: The source has no profile for this account.
reasons.source_invalid_response: The source returned an invalid profile. Ask an administrator.
reasons.preview_invalid: This preview is no longer valid. Preview again before applying.
reasons.preview_stale: The record changed or the preview expired. Preview again before applying.
reasons.user_not_found: This account no longer exists. Refresh the list.
reasons.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
reasons.forbidden: You lack permission or request verification expired. Reload and try again.
reasons.request_failed: The operation could not be completed. Preview again or ask an administrator.
reasons.invalid_stored_state: The stored policy cannot be safely read. Ask an administrator.
reasons.transaction_unavailable: A safe database transaction is unavailable. No changes were applied.
